bodyLines.text: Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
a dining room with a good view of the 1. _____
a private garden for 2. _____ and for the wedding ceremony
a late-evening buffet with a choice of 6. _____ and hot drinks
Music: hotel will organize a band (not included in price)
Can also recommend a 8. _____ supplier (new company)

transcript.text: [Narrator]: Now listen carefully and answer questions one to five.
[Hotel Staff]: Hello, Clarence House.
[Debbie]: Oh hello.
I'm getting married next year and I understand your license to hold weddings at the hotel
[Hotel Staff]: Yes, we are.
Can I ask what date you were thinking of?
[Debbie]: Either the 1st or the 7th of June.
[Hotel Staff]: Right, let me see.
Oh, I'm afraid we already have a booking for the 7th, but we still have availability on June
the 1st.
[Debbie]: That would be fine. [Hotel Staff]: So, how many guests are you going to be inviting? [Debbie]: About 80. [Hotel Staff]: So for that number, we'd recommend the Oxford suite.
I don't know if you've been to the hotel.
[Debbie]: Yes.
In fact, I went to a wedding there a few years ago and I was really impressed.
[Hotel Staff]: Very good.
[Debbie]: I think we're in the Oxford suite then.
The room where we were eating had big windows with really good views.
You could see right across the city.
[Hotel Staff]: That's it.
If you'd have exclusive access to the garden, it'll be at its best in June.
[Debbie]: So we could have the photos there.
[Hotel Staff]: Sure.
In fact, you can even have the ceremony there if you want.
It makes a lovely background.
[Debbie]: Oh, I hadn't thought of that.
Yes, that's certainly an idea.
And is there somewhere for dancing?
[Hotel Staff]: Yes.
There's plenty of space in the middle of the dining room.
[Debbie]: Oh, yeah.
I remember now.
[Hotel Staff]: So just to give you an idea, would you like me to tell you about our special wedding
package?
[Debbie]: Sure.
[Hotel Staff]: Right.
So for 80 guests, you'd have the exclusive use of the Oxford suite, as I said, and then
a meal.
So that would be in the dining room and that would be a sit-down meal with three courses.
[Debbie]: And how's the room arranged?
I seem to remember you have round tables.
[Hotel Staff]: That's right.
Most people prefer them to long tables.
[Debbie]: Long tables aren't really very friendly, are they?
And what about decorations on the tables?
[Hotel Staff]: They're included in the package.
And we have white linen tablecloths and white chair covers.
And we also include an individually designed menu specially printed for you.
It's something that people can take away to remember the occasion.
That's something we've just started doing this year.
[Debbie]: All right.
[Narrator]: Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at question 6-10.
[Hotel Staff]: And then towards the end of the evening, when everyone's beginning to run out of energy,
we bring in a buffet, nothing too complicated, just a selection of sandwiches together with
tea or coffee.
That's always very popular.
[Debbie]: Right.
And we want some music. Is that included in the package?
[Hotel Staff]: No.
But we could probably get you a DJ.
Or we know of a very good band if you'd prefer that.
[Debbie]: Yes, that'd be better, actually.
Something to get everyone on their feet.
Good.
So apart from the music, you said that's an all-inclusive package.
So how much does that package come to?
[Hotel Staff]: £5,995.
[Debbie]: That's a bit more than the package they quoted for me at the Stanley Hotel.
There's was £4,500.
[Hotel Staff]: Yes.
But I think if you look at what you're getting for the money,
you'll find where the best value.
And it is a big day after all.
[Debbie]: Yes, you're probably right.
Oh, and I nearly forgot.
I'm looking for someone who can make me a really special cake.
Can you suggest one?
[Hotel Staff]: Certainly.
There's a new company that we've started using.
They're very good.
In fact, our wedding coordinator will be able to give you all sorts of advice.
We can offer you a free consultation and a tour of the venue.
[Debbie]: Yes, well, I'd definitely be interested.
[Hotel Staff]: Right.
Well, the coordinator's name is Sarah Izard.
That's I-Z-A-R-D.
Now, when would you like to meet her?
She's available from nine to five most weekdays,
or later, if that's more convenient.
[Debbie]: I'm free on the 12th of October in the morning,
sometime, or the 15th of October.
[Hotel Staff]: That would be better, thanks.
Should we say 11.30?
[Debbie]: Fine.
[Hotel Staff]: Can I just take your name and a contact number?
[Debbie]: Sure. It's Debbie.
[Narrator]: That is the end of part one.
You now have one minute to check your answers to part one.
